Everyday I get messages that are incredibly inappropriate, predatory and sexual from men ranging 17-36! They range from very detailed descriptions of bodily autonomy, I'm sure you get the jist of what these messages contain. reviews.title: no
reviews.text: honestly, WIZZ is one of the most misleading and frustrating apps i’ve ever used. i’ve had this app since december 2024, and for YEARS i’ve wondered why people weren’t responding to my messages, even when i followed their bios and texted twice like they asked. now i’m finding out that messages i thought i was sending normally and for free may actually be getting delivered as secret chats that people have to PAY to open. the problem is that i’m not intentionally choosing to send secret chats, and the app doesn’t make it clear enough that this is happening. i’m sending what i believe are regular messages, but the other person may be unable to read them without paying. one person even confirmed that my messages were coming through as secret chats despite me texting twice. do you understand how frustrating it is to spend YEARS wondering why people aren’t responding, only to discover that the app’s messaging system may be preventing them from even reading what you send? people shouldn’t have to pay to access messages that the sender believes they’re sending normally. if this is how the system works, wiz needs to be TRANSPARENT about it. clearly label secret chats, explain when a message will be sent that way, and stop making users guess whether their messages are actually reaching people. this is a ridiculous system that makes genuine communication unnecessarily difficult. FIX YOUR APP.

reviews.title: Worse app ever. (Read before getting the app)
reviews.text:
For someone that has used this app for 5 years, this is now genuinely one of the worst apps I’ve ever used. I was banned simply for defending myself against a man who was disrespecting and shaming me. Meanwhile, men on this platform are constantly allowed to disrespect women, call them out of their names, make inappropriate sexual comments, and post inappropriate content without facing the same consequences.

The double standards are ridiculous. I wasn’t even allowed to have a profile picture showing my uncovered face, yet I saw multiple men with their faces completely visible on their profiles.

I was also previously banned for promoting my music and saying something that was apparently considered too violent. However, I’ve personally had a man threaten to k1ll me and ask where I lived so he could carry out that threat. Despite how serious that situation was, he was still allowed on the platform.

How is promoting music or defending myself treated more seriously than an actual death threat? If you’re going to enforce community guidelines, they need to apply equally to everyone, regardless of gender.

The selective enforcement, lack of accountability, and obvious double standards are unacceptable. Women should not be punished for standing up for themselves while men are allowed to engage in threatening, disrespectful, and inappropriate behavior. This platform seriously needs to reevaluate how it handles reports, bans, and user safety.

I’ve had this app since 2021 so I’ve been its phases. The app is constantly being updated whenever it adds a feature, removes a feature, changes how a feature works, or completely changes the layout of the app. Super annoying to have to readjust every month or so but whatever. One of the apps features was you could use coins to buy boosts, and the way you got coins was by purchasing them with real money, or logging in for daily rewards. Only problem is that the daily rewards are about 5-30 coins a day, and the average price for a single boost is about 100 coins. Since I’ve had this app for so long I’ve accumulated around 300 that were currently sitting in my account. The apps last update was that they were removing coins all together and you had to buy the boosts with real money all together. And they took the coins you already had and turned them into boosts so you technically didn’t lose anything. Well that’s fine whatever- except today when I opened the app I see the coins section is back, the daily rewards is back, and my inventory is 0! This developers are so money hungry and greedy and it’s literally driven the app to the ground. I’m not saying they staged a coup to wipe out everyone’s coin count- but it sure as hell looks like it.

Trust me when I say this app is NOT WORTH IT! Not worth your money or time. You WILL NOT meet anyone interesting or worth your energy on this app. If you haven’t tried Wizz- don’t. If you have an account, just delete it at this point.

reviews.title: PLEASE fix the music.
reviews.text:
Let me preface this review by first stating that I’ve waited a decent amount of time before actually writing this out, I wanted to see if some of the issues I had with the app would be addressed before I was ready to leave a review, but due to the fact we just recently received an update last week and my biggest issues were still not addressed I’m going to go ahead and leave this review now. 

In my opinion the best part of this app; expression wise, is the fact that you can express yourself on your bios through the type of music that you add to them. I can’t hear not only the music on my own profile, but the music on 95% of other users profiles as well. I’ve been patiently waiting for this to get fixed and it’s growing quite tiresome. How long before this is addressed? Why are you continuing to charge users money when core features of your app aren’t even functioning properly? The way you’re handling incentivizing users to pay is already egregious, but it becomes even more so when the app is not even delivering the whole of what is promised from the experience. How is this being genuine and showing good business ethic to your users? 

The app may have been successful enough to launch your company into a realm that isn’t unfamiliar with the dollar… but that doesn’t mean that it is impossible for you guys to stagnate and eventually lose favor to the point where your user base and subsequent revenue decline significantly due to a lack of initiative on your parts. reviews.title: Moderation system & you need to pay for EVERYTHING now.
reviews.text:
I MADE AN EDIT TO THIS REVIEW, SEE BOTTOM. DO NOT GET THIS APP

This is the 3rd time I've been restricted for doing nothing. I think there might be a cap on messages you can send, since I did nothing to warrant a ban. That's really dumb since there's a "bulk chat" feature that sends the same message to 100 people. I read the terms of service and I didn't find anything that explained why I was banned. I can't get in contact with a real person, and still have no idea why I was banned any of the times. It's a good app, but the moderation honestly ruins it. I've had some great conversations stopped due to this.

Edit: they made the app even worse! A bit ago they made it so you need to pay coins to see who messaged you, which was whatever. Bad change but not uninstall worthy since you get coins daily. Just logged on today to see they REMOVED all free coins from the daily rewards. If you want to talk to people, you need to pay now. Even if you do pay, there's a low chance your message gets seen because whoever you're texting needs to pay as well. Never get this app. Use yubo is now unfortunately the better option which really shows how terrible they made the app. Just use any other friend finding app other than this one. Truly disappointing.

reviews.title: Completely broken
reviews.text: The app worked fine until about 2 months ago when I went from 20+ profile views a day and several requests to nothing at all. Not even one view. I even went ahead of myself and bought boosters but still nothing. Money wasted. And then I had the brilliant idea to go email support and use the horrible help chatbot which - unsurprisingly did absolutely nothing. And before anyone was wondering I’m not restricted , banned , anything negative about my account. My personal money wasted and so along with a lot of my time. Also not to mention the fake notifications you get. Recently I got a glimmer of hope that I got a singular profile view but once I clicked on it - again - nothing. I hope this app finally sorts itself out

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
The community is okay, sometimes people are really weird and sometimes they’re alright. The people at Wizz themselves, however, are no help at all. 

I paid for a special bundle and I also bought some coins. However, none of the items I bought were credited to my account. I tried to message the support team about it and got a useless ai chat bot which eventually ended the chat and said that my message would be “reviewed by a member of their team.” I didn’t get any replies to my question. Subsequently, I messaged them again a couple days later asking if they could find out why I didn’t receive my items and if they could give them to me, seeing as I had paid. Again, no reply.

I’m not sure if this issue has only happened with me or if there are other people dealing with the same issue, either way this is unacceptable. Even though it was only a small amount of money, my issue isn’t with the money, it’s the fact that they ignored my messages completely. 

I gave them about a week to answer, obviously I don’t expect them to be working around Christmas, but after the 28th, surely they have some team members working from home?

Like I said, the people you meet on the app are a hit or miss, but i can’t say I’ve had a good experience with the support staff.

I’ve now deleted my account.
